subject: Node commissioning manifest & sanity verification
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Eric Holt <eric.holt@acmecloud.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Node commissioning manifest & sanity verification

Eric / Daniel —

Attached is the commissioning manifest we'll run during the window tomorrow morning (see attached PDF and the network stitching map). This is the final smoke protocol and handoff plan for the private deployment in Acme's ORD cluster. High level notes:

- Start window: 2027-12-10 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET. Targeted duration: 3 hours with contingency for additional 90m.
- Primary goals: validate control-plane connectivity, north-south routing to customer ingress, KV cache priming across the edge nodes, and end-to-end inference sample checks against the test harness.
- Must-haves before we start: L3 adjacency verified between Redwood edge nodes and Acme transit (Daniel), ACLs pushed (Acme SRE), and BGP communities accepted for prefix steering (Eric).

Please confirm the window and call signs for the bridge. I have listed runbook steps in sequence within the manifest — we plan to execute in order and record the smoke CSV output to attach to this thread.

Attachments: node-commissioning-manifest-v1.pdf, network-stitching-map-v2.png

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Program Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0188

---

From: Eric Holt <eric.holt@acmecloud.com>

Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Node commissioning manifest & sanity verification

Priya —

Thanks for the manifest. Window works for us. We'll stand up the transit engineers at 10:30 ET to confirm BGP neighbors and community tagging. Quick callouts from our side before the run:

- We've validated ACL staging in our preprod and will push to prod ACLs at 07:45 PT.
- The transit team found one mismatched subnet in your stitch map (Edge node 3 shows 10.12.3.0/24; our fabric is 10.12.30.0/24). We'll correct on our side but can you confirm the intended /24?
- Bridge: Acme Bridge (Zoom) ID 867-234-1100, 10:50 PT join for quick adjacency checks; official start at 11:00 PT.

I'll circulate the transit verification checklist right after this note.

—Eric
Eric Holt
Principal Cloud Network Engineer
Acme Cloud Services
eric.holt@acmecloud.com | +1-312-555-0147

Subject: Re: Node commissioning manifest & sanity verification

Thanks for the quick turn, Eric — good catch on the subnet.

For clarity: the intended CIDR for edge node 3 is 10.12.30.0/24 (the map PDF had an earlier draft coordinate that slipped through). Karthik — please confirm your node config has 10.12.30.0/24 and push the corrected interface before we open the window.

Operational notes for the team:

- Karthik to perform control-plane adjacency check at 10:45 PT and post the BGP state to the bridge.
- Marissa will be monitoring token-level latencies and will start the KV cache priming sequence at 11:05 PT once adjacency is confirmed.
- Markus will be the final go/no-go approver if we hit any top-level failures and will coordinate rollback.

On the attachments: I've added a small checklist page to the manifest for quick runbook playback and timing markers — please use that to annotate issues during the run. We'll collect the smoke CSV and paste into this thread after the run.

Thanks — see you on the bridge.

-Priya

Date: Fri, 10 Dec 2027 13:42:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Node commissioning manifest & sanity verification — smoke results and handback

All —

Quick runout and outcomes below (recorded on the manifest and attached CSV). TL;DR: green with one minor route flapping that was auto-mitigated, KV priming completed, and inference sample checks passed within latency SLOs.

Summary log (high level):
- 10:45 PT: BGP adjacency established (peers: RWD-Edge1/2/3 <-> ACME-Transit-A/B).
- 11:05 PT: KV cache priming started; warmup completed by 11:18 PT (priming success rate 99.7%).
- 11:24 PT: Inference test harness ran 1000 samples across the staged RT traffic; 995 passed end-to-end correctness gates. Median per-token latency 28ms; 95th 82ms (within agreed SLO).
- 11:37 PT: Observed brief route flap on ACME transit for prefix 10.12.30.0/24 for ~90s; transit team applied dampening and route stabilized. No client impact observed.

Attachments: smoke-results-20271210.csv (contains step-by-step CSV of runbook annotations and sample metrics).

Markus — based on this, recommend signoff to proceed with gradual traffic handover at 14:00 PT. If you approve, we'll kick the staged roll (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and monitor for 60 mins at each stage.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Reliability (Private Deployments)
Redwood Inference
